verses.html: 31 Then Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.
verses.text: 31 Then Jesus left the region of Tyre and went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.

verses.html: 32 Some people brought to Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged Jesus to place His hand on him.
verses.text: 32 Some people brought to Him a man who was deaf and hardly able to speak, and they begged Jesus to place His hand on him.

verses.html: 33 So Jesus took him aside privately, away from the crowd, and put His fingers into the man’s ears. Then He spit and touched the man’s tongue.
verses.text: 33 So Jesus took him aside privately, away from the crowd, and put His fingers into the man’s ears. Then He spit and touched the man’s tongue.

verses.html: 34 And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).
verses.text: 34 And looking up to heaven, He sighed deeply and said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means, “Be opened!”).

verses.html: 35 Immediately the man’s ears were opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak plainly.
verses.text: 35 Immediately the man’s ears were opened and his tongue was released, and he began to speak plainly.

verses.html: 36 Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone. But the more He ordered them, the more widely they proclaimed it.
verses.text: 36 Jesus ordered them not to tell anyone. But the more He ordered them, the more widely they proclaimed it.

verses.html: 37 The people were utterly astonished and said, “He has done all things well! He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”
verses.text: 37 The people were utterly astonished and said, “He has done all things well! He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

verses.html: 31 And again having gone out from the region of Tyre, he went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee, in the midst of the region of the Decapolis.
verses.text: 31 And again having gone out from the region of Tyre, he went through Sidon to the Sea of Galilee, in the midst of the region of the Decapolis.

verses.html: 32 And they bring to him {one} deaf and barely able to speak, and they beg him that he would lay his hand on him.

verses.html: 33 And having taken him aside from the crowd by himself, he put his fingers into his ears, and having spit, he touched his tongue.
verses.text: 33 And having taken him aside from the crowd by himself, he put his fingers into his ears, and having spit, he touched his tongue.

verses.html: 34 And having looked up to heaven, he sighed and says to him, “Ephphatha!” (that is, “Be opened!”).
verses.text: 34 And having looked up to heaven, he sighed and says to him, “Ephphatha!” (that is, “Be opened!”).

verses.html: 35 And his ears were opened, and the bond of his tongue was loosed, and he began speaking rightly.
verses.text: 35 And his ears were opened, and the bond of his tongue was loosed, and he began speaking rightly.

verses.html: 36 And he commanded them so that they would tell {it} to no one. But as much as he commanded them, the more abundantly they were proclaiming {it}.

verses.html: 37 And they were extremely astonished, saying, “He has done all things well, and he makes the deaf to hear and the mute to speak.”
verses.text: 37 And they were extremely astonished, saying, “He has done all things well, and he makes the deaf to hear and the mute to speak.”

verses.html: 31 Then, Jesus {and his apprentices} left the areas near the city of Tyre. They walked through the areas near the city of Sidon and eventually arrived near the Sea of Galilee in the region of the Ten Towns.
verses.text: 31 Then, Jesus {and his apprentices} left the areas near the city of Tyre. They walked through the areas near the city of Sidon and eventually arrived near the Sea of Galilee in the region of the Ten Towns.

verses.html: 32 Then, people led to Jesus a man who could not hear and who could not speak well. They urged Jesus to {heal him by} touching him.
verses.text: 32 Then, people led to Jesus a man who could not hear and who could not speak well. They urged Jesus to {heal him by} touching him.

verses.html: 33 So, Jesus brought the man to a place where no one from the large group of people was with them. He stuck one of his fingers into each of the man’s ears. Then, he spit and touched the man’s tongue.
verses.text: 33 So, Jesus brought the man to a place where no one from the large group of people was with them. He stuck one of his fingers into each of the man’s ears. Then, he spit and touched the man’s tongue.

verses.html: 34 Next, Jesus groaned as he prayed to God. Then he told the man, “Ephphatha!” That means, “Open up!”
verses.text: 34 Next, Jesus groaned as he prayed to God. Then he told the man, “Ephphatha!” That means, “Open up!”

verses.html: 35 After that, the man could hear. Also, Jesus had corrected what was wrong with his mouth, so he could speak properly.
verses.text: 35 After that, the man could hear. Also, Jesus had corrected what was wrong with his mouth, so he could speak properly.

verses.html: 36 After that, Jesus ordered the people {who were nearby} not to tell anyone {about what he had done}. However, every time he ordered them {not to do so}, they told even more people {about what he had done}.

verses.html: 37 When people learned what Jesus had done, it greatly impressed them. They declared, “Everything that he does is good! He enables people who could not hear to hear. He enables people who could not speak to speak.”
